summary: Implemented account-level commission overrides with explicit percentage/fixed/exempt values, effective windows, source-attributed account read models, optimistic versions, deterministic lists, active overlap prevention, and fallback to an effective default policy or none.

verification.command: npm.cmd run build --workspace packages/contracts; npm.cmd run typecheck --workspace apps/api; node --test --import tsx apps/api/tests/commissions/service.test.ts
verification.notes: Contracts/API typecheck passed and two focused commission tests passed.

verification.command: npm.cmd run typecheck; npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd test -- --runInBand; npm.cmd run build
verification.notes: Typecheck and lint passed; full suite passed 365 tests; build succeeded.

verification.command: npm.cmd audit --audit-level=high; npm.cmd run api:inventory; npm.cmd run openapi:validate; npm.cmd run postman:validate; node agent_pack/scripts/audit_pack.mjs; git diff --check
verification.notes: No high-severity vulnerabilities; inventory, OpenAPI, Postman, Agent Pack audit, and whitespace checks passed.

knownGaps: The account override service is an in-memory boundary; persistent storage, audit/change-log, and full resolver snapshots are later B8 tasks.
No provider-facing HTTP route was added; provider read-only projection is a later dependent task.
No production account or commission values were seeded and no financial settlement is performed.
Live database/provider integration checks were not run because no isolated replica-set topology or credentials were available.
